clips.title: The story
paras: In the Valley of Trials, Glyphic Parchment points young mages toward their first lessons. Gornek delivers the runed notice, which sends them to Mai'ah near the Den to begin learning the arcane.

New recruits test their strength against Durotar's local pests, but those drawn to magic need more than brute force. Gornek passes along a notice marked with runes. It directs novice spellcasters to Mai'ah, who guides the Horde's newest recruits through their first lessons in magic.

Mai'ah waits just outside the Den, where she teaches young spellweavers to temper ambition with patience and thought. She urges them to choose their moment instead of hurling raw sorcery without care. In her lessons, novices learn to weave delicate strands of the cosmos rather than unleash an unruly tempest.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Ah, while you were gone a parchment came for you, friend.
Read it when you have time. If I'm not mistaken, it came from the adventurer trainer Mai'ah. She would have words with you when you're ready.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Ya come to Mai'ah ready to learn. Dat be good. Ya got da power to touch da strands of da cosmos, but ya also got da wisdom to know dat you need guidance. I can teach ya da first steps to wield dat power.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Da magic dat flows through you be da greatest power in da universe, but ya must be patient. Wait for da perfect moment to strike. Choose da right response to da problem at hand. If you be smart, and you watch carefully, dere be nothing you can't do.
When ya tink you be ready for trainin', come back to Mai'ah. She teach you what you ready to learn, no problem.
